findings.current:
Their senses and minds had simply frozen in the frost-like magical power, too slow to respond.

They remembered *that day*, which had come without a word of warning just a few decades ago.
findings.defect: The draft says they remembered that day; the source says their frozen senses and minds had not yet reacted to its memory.
findings.rationale: 기억을 is the object of 미처 제때 반응하지 못했을 뿐이다, not a separate assertion that they remembered.
findings.replacement: Their senses and minds, frozen by the icy magical power, simply hadn’t reacted in time to the memory of *that day*—the day that had arrived without a word of warning just a few decades ago.
findings.source:
다만 서릿발 같은 마력에 얼어붙은 오감과 정신이 미처 제때 반응하지 못했을 뿐이다.

지금으로부터 불과 수십 년 전, 한 마디의 예고도 없이 찾아온 ‘그날’의 기억을.

findings.current: When a spearhead wreathed in flames cut through the thick storm clouds covering Moscow’s sky alongside Morgoth,
findings.defect: “Alongside Morgoth” makes him appear to cut the clouds with the spearhead. The spearhead cut through both Morgoth and the clouds.
findings.rationale: 모르고스와 함께 joins Morgoth to the clouds as what the spearhead cut through.
findings.replacement: When a spearhead wreathed in flames cut through Morgoth and the thick storm clouds covering Moscow’s sky,
findings.source: 화염을 머금은 창날이 모르고스와 함께 모스크바의 하늘을 뒤덮고 있던 짙은 먹구름을 베어 가른 그때

findings.current: the Undead King held his unconscious friend in his arms and felt the warmth coming from his fingertips.
findings.defect: The warmth is felt through his fingertips, not emitted by them.
findings.rationale: 손끝을 타고 전해지는 describes warmth reaching him through his fingertips while he holds his friend.
findings.replacement: the Undead King held his unconscious friend in his arms and felt warmth pass into his fingertips.
findings.source: 의식을 잃은 친구를 품에 안은 언데드 킹은 손끝을 타고 전해지는 온기를 느꼈다.

findings.current: “More than twenty percent of them have reached the point where they’re likely to become Monster Waves…”
findings.defect: “Likely” turns the reported threshold for progression into a probability judgment.
findings.rationale: 몬스터 웨이브로 진행될 정도의 수치 specifies a level sufficient for progression; 약 20퍼센트 이상 is approximately twenty percent or more.
findings.replacement: “At least twenty percent of them have reached levels high enough to progress into Monster Waves…”
findings.source: “그중 약 20퍼센트 이상의 게이트가 몬스터 웨이브로 진행될 정도의 수치로…….”

findings.current: A dazzling beam of light—so muffled that it could hardly be called light and darkness at the same time—sealed the sky. This time, it never opened again.
findings.defect: The draft’s comparison is incoherent: the source contrasts the beam’s dazzling appearance with calling it darkness, while also describing its oppressive quality.
findings.rationale: 눈부신 contrasts with 어둠이라는 단어와는 도저히 함께할 수 없는; 먹먹한 gives the beam its oppressive quality.
findings.replacement: Dazzling. That oppressive beam, so bright it seemed impossible to call it darkness, closed the sky. This time, it never opened again.
findings.source: 눈부신. 어둠이라는 단어와는 도저히 함께할 수 없는 그 먹먹한 빛줄기가 하늘을 닫았고 이번에는 두 번 다시 열리지 않았다.

findings.current:
> **Mission:** Defeat [“Black Dragon Duke” Morgoth] (Complete)
>
> Halt the Rift’s progress (Incomplete)
>
> **System**
>
> Main Quest [Rift and Collapse] has failed.
>
> A new Main Quest, [Inevitable Collapse], has been created.
findings.defect: Consecutive System notices are split by a second heading, UI names retain prohibited square brackets, and “Inevitable” asserts more than 예정된.
findings.rationale: These are consecutive notices in one System window. 예정된 means planned or predetermined, not necessarily impossible to avert.
findings.replacement:
> **Mission:** Defeat “Black Dragon Duke” Morgoth (Complete)
>
> Halt the Rift’s progress (Incomplete)
>
> Main Quest Rift and Collapse has failed.
>
> A new Main Quest, Predestined Collapse, has been created.

findings.current: the evil Dragon that had terrorized countless worlds for thousands of years
findings.defect: “Countless worlds” introduces multiple worlds where the source describes terror throughout the world.
findings.rationale: 뭇 세상 refers broadly to the world, not a count of separate worlds.
findings.replacement: the evil Dragon that had terrorized the whole world for thousands of years
findings.source: 지난 수천 년간 뭇 세상을 공포로 몰아넣었던 악룡

findings.defect: “At last” suggests welcome relief; 결국 marks a feared outcome finally coming to pass.
findings.rationale: The speakers are acknowledging the onset of Code Black, not celebrating its arrival.

summary: The draft reverses two scene details and weakens several consequential details of the spreading catastrophe.
